name: agent-refinement
body: Refine the apg agent suite — the six distributed agents, the agent-builder template, and the generated project agents — so that every agent reaches the code graph only through the apg tools (never raw files), tool failures are terminal and reported up, the `question` tool is coordinator/agent-builder-only, and the implementer may edit `opencode-suite/**` while `.opencode/**` stays agent-builder-only.
